analyst.summary: Physicswallah continues to grow revenue rapidly (around 35% over the past year) on its affordable, digital-first exam-prep and upskilling model, and has meaningfully reduced its debt even while continuing to invest in growth, including a recent acquisition deepening its UPSC-prep offering. The company is still loss-making, which is not unusual for a newly-listed, fast-scaling business, but it does mean the path to sustainable profitability -- rather than the growth rate itself -- is the main thing to watch from here, especially given India's edtech sector has seen high-profile disappointments before.
